equation.tau_total: sum(force-model wrenches) - B_rad*nu_rel - B_linear*nu_rel - B_quadratic*(abs(nu_rel) elementwise nu_rel) + hydrostatics - C(M,nu_rel)*nu_rel
equation.yaw_acceleration_exact: component 5 of inverse(M_RB + A)*tau_total; not a scalar isolated-axis division because the symmetrized 6x6 added-mass matrix contains coupling

differencing.method: central difference for interior samples; forward/backward one-sided endpoints
differencing.comparison: central finite difference of RK4 state against exact endpoint derivative recomputed and retained by CoupledSixPlant

physical_limit_check.note: Heading-only lower bounds ignore translation, cross-track recovery and subsequent damping; satisfying them is necessary but not sufficient for route recapture.
